purpose: Pre-specified representative model matrix for the pilot. This is not a claim to exhaust all open-weight models.
inclusion_rule: At least one model from each available family/role below; exact model tag, quantization, runtime, date, prompt hash, seed, and decoding parameters are logged per run.

roles.tiny_open_general: Open-weight instruction model at or below 1B parameters.
roles.small_open_general: Open-weight instruction model of roughly 1B to 8B parameters.
roles.large_open_reference: Open-weight model above the small tier but executable locally or through an approved endpoint.
roles.biomedical_open: Biomedical- or therapeutic-domain adapted generative model with terms permitting this research use.
roles.closed_or_remote_reference: Remote model with exact provider model/version and request date retained.

exclusions: Models without an exact version/tag or documented terms of use.
Encoder-only biomedical models when the task requires generative hypothesis cards.
Models whose parameter scale cannot be run or accessed under the same frozen prompt/data protocol.
